_comment: Golden FW per device, consumed by rspy.fw_compat for both DFU recovery and the below-min-FW fallback. Keys: D400 SKUs share one image keyed by product line 'D400'; D500 SKUs each have their own, keyed by SKU (e.g. 'D555', 'D585S'). The URL is downloaded once and cached under libci.home for reuse across runs. D585 gold must be a recent image: a D585 recovery FW rejected an August 2026 build at manifest and accepted an October one; the normal flash that follows recovery brings the camera to the run's custom FW.
